intro: After helping Rin'ji, you carry a tablet etched with Witherbark troll markings that nobody has yet read. Oran Snakewrithe, who studies the Witherbark, might decipher it, and lives in the Magic Quarter of the Undercity.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The tablet is covered with Witherbark troll markings. Rin'ji's secret truly is a mystery...

It's possible that you might have something quite valuable on your hands here. On the other hand, quite the opposite is also possible. A Witherbark troll in distress would probably do anything to find his way out of trouble...

clips.title: Completion
paras: This tablet... Quite unusual... Where did you find this, friend?
